title: Project-oriented supply chain and innovation strategies for competitive advantage: an empirical study of SMEs in West Java
core_idea: To investigate how supply chain management practices and innovation strategies relate to competitive advantage, and whether operational performance mediates those relationships among SMEs in West Java, using a quantitative survey and structural equation modeling.
tldr: This study aims to assess relationships between SCM practices, innovation strategies, operational performance, and competitive advantage for West Java SMEs via a survey of managers/owners analyzed with SEM (AMOS).
